title: Villager Breeding Tweaks
description: A plugin that decreases villager breeding cooldown and growing age, making villager breeding and growth faster for survival servers and SMPs.
body:
# Villager Breeding Tweaks

Villager Breeding Tweaks is a lightweight and configurable Minecraft plugin that makes villager breeding and growth significantly faster. By reducing villager breeding cooldowns and decreasing baby villager grow-up time, the plugin helps players spend less time waiting and more time progressing.

This plugin is perfect for SMP, survival, and economy-based servers where villagers play an important role in trading halls, iron farms, and overall progression. Vanilla villager mechanics can often feel slow and repetitive, especially for multiplayer servers. Villager Breeding Tweaks improves the experience while still keeping gameplay balanced and close to vanilla.

## Features

* Faster villager breeding
* Reduced baby villager growing age
* Lightweight and optimized
* Easy configuration support
* SMP and survival friendly
* Improves trading hall progression
* Compatible with modern Paper/Spigot servers

Whether you want quicker villager farms, smoother SMP progression, or simply less waiting, Villager Breeding Tweaks provides a simple and efficient solution.
